description: NI 176 - Working age people with access to employment by public transport (and other specified modes) is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government. This indicator measures the percentage of people of working age (aged 16 to 74 years) living within the catchment area of a location with more than 500 jobs by public transport and/or walking. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2014-01-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
